newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hostages at Japan envoy home in Lima named - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Hostages at Japan envoy home in Lima named - Kyodo.

text.p: Here is a list of those taken hostage by a guerrilla group at the Lima residence of the Japanese ambassador to Peru, according to Japan's Kyodo news agency:
Peruvian politicians - Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela, Agriculture Minister Rodolfo Munante Sanguineti and speaker of parliament.
Japanese Ambassador and Japanese embassy staff: Amabassador Morihisa Aoki, minister Hiroyuki Kimoto and 12 Japanese staff.
Japan aid agency: Umeo Koganemaru, chief advisor of the Japan International Cooperation Agency, Foreign Ministry aid arm.
Foreign ambassadors and embassy staff: Ambassadors from Austria, Germany, Brazil, Bolivia, Cuba, Venezuela, South Korea, Malaysia, Spain, Panama. Charges d'affaires from Poland.
Japanese firms in Peru:
Matsushita Electric Industrial Co. Ltd. --
Shigeru Taki, head of Matsushita Peru and three Japanese staff.
Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co. Ltd. -- Shuji
Saito, head of energy department at Tokyo headquarters, Yoshiaki Kitagawa, head of Lima branch and four Japanese staff.
Tomen Corp. -- Atsushi Iwamoto, Lima branch head
and one Peruvian staff.
Nissho Iwai Corp. -- Lima branch head Shigenori
Sato and one Japanese staff
Kanematsu Corp. -- Lima branch head Atsushi
Morizono and one Japanese staff
Mitsui & Co. Ltd -- Masami Kobayashi, head of
Mitsui Peru and three Japanese staff.
Marubeni Corp.-- Keiichi Saito, head of Lima
branch and two Japanese staff.
Mitsubishi Corp. -- Akira Miyashita, head of
Mitsubishi Peru and two Japanese staff.
Ajinomoto Co. Inc. -- Yoshihiko Sakai, head of
Ajinomoto Peru and two staff.
NEC Corp. -- Lima branch head Masazumi Takada
and one Japanese staff.
Toyota Motor Corp. -- Masaru Tomita, head of
Toyota Peru and one Japanese staff.
Nissan Motor Co. Ltd. -- Head of Nissan Peru
Carlos Canbana.
Asahi Chemical Industry Co. Ltd. -- Hideo
Nozaki, head of Asahi Chemical Peru.
Fujita Corp. -- Shunsuke Fujita, Lima branch
head.
Japan Water Works (Jogesuido) Co. -- Nobuo Matsunaga,
head of local project manager and four Japanese staff.
Japan Airlines (JAL) Co. Ltd. -- Masanori Sugimaru, head
of local affiliate.
Japan Bonita and Tuna Fishing Association -- Tateo
Kawakami, head of Lima branch.
Members of Japanese associations and school staff:
Teachers sent to Japanese school in Lima -- Shigeru
Yamazaki and four staff.
Members of 12 Japanese associations -- Ten Japanese and
22 Japanese-Peruvians.
